name: Aura Chat Button
author: Aura Plugin

sections.description:
WhatsApp Chat Button for WordPress – Add a professional floating WhatsApp button to your website. Connect with visitors instantly through WhatsApp chat with beautiful button styles, business hours scheduling, click statistics, and conversion tracking.

Aura Chat Button is the perfect WhatsApp contact solution for customer support, sales inquiries, and lead generation.

Key Features

  • 4 Professional Button Styles – Choose from Elegant Round, Embossed 3D Round, Modern Square, or Deluxe Square designs
  • Custom Colors – Select from Green, Purple, Gold presets or use your own custom color
  • Working Hours Scheduling – Set available days and times, show offline message outside business hours
  • Statistics Dashboard – Track chat opens, conversions, and conversion rates with beautiful charts
  • Mobile Optimization – Separate settings for mobile devices including size and position
  • Page Visibility Control – Show button only on selected page types (homepage, posts, pages, categories)
  • Position Fine-tuning – Adjust horizontal and vertical position with pixel precision
  • Auto Popup – Automatically open chat box after specified seconds
  • Custom Avatar – Upload your own avatar image for personalized appearance
  • Offline Mode – Display custom message and still allow contact when offline

Languages

  • English (default)
  • Türkçe (Turkish) – 100%
  • Deutsch (German) – 100%
  • Español (Spanish) – 100%
  • Français (French) – 100%
  • Italiano (Italian) – 100%
  • Português (Portuguese) – 100%
  • हिन्दी (Hindi) – 100%
  • 中文 (Chinese) – 100%
  • Русский (Russian) – 100%
  • 日本語 (Japanese) – 100%

Perfect For

  • Customer support
  • Sales inquiries
  • Lead generation
  • Quick contact option
  • Service businesses
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aura-chat-button folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to ‘Aura Chat Button’ in the admin menu
  4. Enter your phone number with country code (e.g., 905551234567)
  5. Customize the appearance and settings as desired
  6. Save changes and the widget will appear on your site
sections.faq:
How do I enter my phone number?

Enter your phone number with country code but without + sign or spaces. For example, if your number is +90 555 123 4567, enter it as 905551234567.

Can I show the button only on certain pages?

Yes! Go to the Page Visibility section in settings and select which page types should display the button (Homepage, Static Pages, Blog Posts, Categories).

How does the scheduling feature work?

Enable scheduling in the settings, select your timezone, choose available days, and set start/end times. Outside these hours, visitors will see an offline message but can still send a message.

Can I track how many people click the button?

Yes! The Statistics tab shows chat opens, conversions (clicks to chat), and conversion rates with daily breakdown charts.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Absolutely! There are dedicated mobile settings where you can adjust button size, position, and even hide the tooltip on mobile for a cleaner look.

Can I change the button color?

Yes, you can choose from preset colors (Green, Purple, Gold) or use a custom color picker to match your brand.
